newsitem.title: GERMANY: SGL Carbon to create new specific capital.
newsitem.headline: SGL Carbon to create new specific capital.

text.p: FRANKFURT, March 11 (Reuter ) - German carbon and graphite maker SGL Carbon AG plans to ready itself for new takeovers by asking shareholders to allow it to issue certain new paper.

The Wiesbaden-based group said on Tuesday that it would ask its shareholders to allow the group to raise capital earmarked to issue options and convertible bonds for a volume of up to 300 million marks with a maturity of up to 10 years.
The group also said it planned to use part of the authorised capital in order to fulfil some of its incentive programmes for senior managers in the company.
SGL Carbon said the issues could also be made in other currencies and that the shareholders' permission to do these things would be valid to 2002.
Shareholders would permission the issue of options and convertible bonds on new SGL Carbon shares with a total nominal volume of up to 10 million marks.
But senior management wants to reserve the right to exclude residual amountS from the subscription ratio.

The group would need to create new earmarked capital of up to 10 million marks in nominal valued through the issue of up to two million new shares would be necessary to excercise the convertible bonds and options, it said.
SGL Carbon has always said it planned to grow through new takeovers.
